This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The report creation and update endpoints accept non-existent calendar dates like 2027-02-29 and pass them to the database, resulting in a Postgres 500 error instead of a 400 bad request.
